incident-bot: PAGER: production alert KVC-2026-031 — kv-cache eviction rate spike + continuous-microbatch backlog. p95/p99 token latency climbing. paging #eng-oncall :rotating_light: (root ts 2154307890)

Samir Patel: on it. seeing the page, assigning a triage. @Anya can you pull the eviction/usage heatmap and last deploys?

Anya Li: pulling metrics now. eviction rate jumped ~7x at 09:12 UTC, sustained for ~8m. KV resident set shrank and batch window distribution shows longer tails (microbatch aggregator queues growing). No obvious CPU/GPU saturation. dashboard: https://graf.redwood/internal/d/kv/evictions?from=now-30m

Mike O'Connor: any recent changes to batching config or kernel selection? I see a canary of `microbatch-v2` kicked at 08:50 by releasebot for a small customer slice.

Tara Gomez: yep that canary was rolled this morning. runbook suggests immediate mitigation: reduce `microbatch_window_ms` to previous baseline and enable per-tenant override for heavy customers.

Anya Li: logs (sample):
```
[09:12:03] kv-serving node-12 WARN eviction: tenant=acme-corp resident=48MB target=512MB evict_rate=120/s
[09:12:07] batch-agg WARN queue_len=384 avg_window_ms=45 p99=223
[09:12:10] runtime INFO kernel_selector: picked quant-kernel-v3 for seq_len=1024
```

Samir Patel: ok. immediate plan: 1) apply per-tenant override to reduce batch window for the top affected tenants (acme-corp, betaretail, alpha-fin) 2) roll back the `microbatch-v2` canary to stable on a small slice 3) monitor p99 and eviction rate for 10m before widening rollout.

Tara Gomez: commands to apply override (internal flag service):
```
# quick override for acme-corp (sets microbatch window to 6ms)
curl -s -X POST https://ff.redwood.internal/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"flag":"microbatch_window_ms","tenant":"acme-corp","value":6}'

# verify
curl -s https://ff.redwood.internal/overrides?tenant=acme-corp | jq
```

Mike O'Connor: deploying override now for acme-corp. will validate on serving logs.

sre-bot: Action logged: override applied for tenant=acme-corp flag=microbatch_window_ms value=6 by Mike O'Connor at 2154307985.

Anya Li: initial telemetry after override (09:15): eviction rate down ~60% for acme-corp, batch queue length reduced. p99 latency improving but still elevated in aggregate due to other tenants.

Samir Patel: good. next: rollback canary for microbatch-v2. Releasebot, kick the rollback.

releasebot: deploy-bot: rolling back canary `microbatch-v2` from slice id=slice-114. Initiating canary rollback; expected 2m to complete.

Tara Gomez: while rollback runs, I'm going to prepare a per-customer emergency policy: `per_cust_batch_limit=true` to cap batch growth. This is a temporary safety knob (no code change).

Priya Rao: taking over triage from Samir (handing off). Current state: acme-corp override applied, roll back in progress, system-wide evictions trending down but a few tenants still showing high queue_len (betaretail). I'll apply overrides to betaretail next and then alpha-fin if needed.

Samir Patel: thanks Priya. Mike, can you also force a small kv prefix flush for the worst tenant after override? runbook step: `kvctl flush-prefix --tenant acme-corp --prefix 'user:'`

Mike O'Connor: doing flush-prefix for acme-corp now.

sre-bot: kvctl: flush-prefix job queued job_id=flush-2154308022 tenant=acme-corp

Anya Li: rollback completed at 09:20. releasebot: canary rollback succeeded. microbatch aggregator back to baseline on canary hosts.

Priya Rao: summary for on-call handoff: - mitigation applied: per-tenant override (acme-corp=6ms) + prefix flush - canary rollback completed - telemetry: eviction rate overall down ~55%, p95 latency improving - next: apply override to betaretail, monitor 10m, then remove overrides gradually and schedule postmortem.

Leo Zhang: quick note — we'll open an infra ticket to add a safety limit on continuous-batching window growth and add a regression test for microbatch kernel selector. filing now: https://phabricator.redwood/T-8921

Priya Rao: action items assigned: Mike (expand overrides to betaretail + alpha-fin if metrics require), Tara (write up temporary policy + runbook edits), Anya (collect graphs/snippets for postmortem), Leo (infra ticket), Samir (postmortem owner). I'll stay on until health is green.

Samir Patel: thanks everyone. keep status updates here. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: 10:00 update — all major tenants back to stable behaviour, I'm going to mark incident as mitigated and start a follow-up doc. handoff to daytime eng team at 10:05. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT KVC-2026-031 mitigated by: per-tenant overrides + canary rollback. Closing page."
